title: Shisha Cloudz – Green Grape 100ml
description:
Shisha Cloudz – White Gummi 100ml
Green Grape shisha is a delightful and crisp flavor that captures the essence of fresh, ripe green grapes. It offers a natural and juicy grape taste that’s both sweet and slightly tart, making it a perfect choice for those seeking a light and palate-pleasing hookah sensation.
Shisha Cloudz e-juices come with 0mg nicotine level and a 70VG/30PG ratio.
